interview.name: Rey
interview.answer: The repair drive is at the community shed by the tables, but no time is given in the notes.

reflections: Rey is cooperative and quickly moves from asking for directions to offering hands-on help.
Tess acts as an information relay, staying responsive and promising follow-up updates.
Gus is welcoming and practical, giving clear location guidance to help Rey get involved.
Rey is the main coordinator for the repair drive, repeatedly providing location and logistics updates to others.
The others are responsive and cooperative, mostly asking for practical details and confirming they will come or help.
There is some uncertainty around event timing, so Rey is acting as the point person for follow-up information.
Rey is the central organizer for the repair drive and is actively coordinating logistics at the community shed tables.
Pia wants precise details before participating, while Rey is still confirming timing and is willing to relay updates.
Nell and Quinn are supportive helpers who are spreading information and gathering supplies, which suggests a collaborative, community-driven effort.
Rey is actively helping organize the repair-drive and is willing to sort incoming donations at the community shed.
Quinn is taking responsibility for coordination by sharing schedules, drop-off spots, and keeping others informed.
Cleo and Rey are cooperating on supplies management, with Cleo tracking inventory and Rey helping at the tables.
Rey is reliably supportive and takes on coordination work, especially around the community shed and repair table.
Cleo is actively managing a repair-drive effort and sharing inventory updates as donations come in.
Quinn and Opal are helping organize logistics, with Quinn supplying schedules and Opal moving between community center and front-entrance setup points.

events.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a lot of donations already. I’ll let you know if I hear anything else useful.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Rey: That’s good to hear. Thanks, Tess — I’d appreciate any updates.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll keep an ear out and tell you if I hear any new details.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Rey: I’ll swing by and see what needs fixing. Just point me to the repair drive and I’ll help where I can.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Gus: Great, thanks, Rey — it’s down by the community shed. I’ll point you to the tables when you get here.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. I’m on my way now and I’ll look for the tables by the shed.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Faye: Thanks — what time and where is the repair drive?
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Rey: I’m heading over now — it’s by the community shed, near the tables. If you need me, I can help once I’m there.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Faye: Thanks — I’m on my way. I’ll meet you by the community shed near the tables.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Pia — I’m on my way to the repair drive now, and I’ll head for the tables by the community shed.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Pia: Thanks — could you send me the exact time and what I should bring? I just want to make sure I’ve got the logistics right.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Rey: I don’t have the exact time yet, but I’ll check when I arrive and let you know. For now, just bring whatever repair items you have and I’ll pass along any updates.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Rey: I’m on my way to the repair drive now, by the community shed near the tables. If you’re bringing anything, just drop it there and I’ll help sort it out.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Nell: Oh, great — I’ll pass that along and keep an ear out for any extra tools or screws.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Nell — that helps a lot. If you hear of any tools or screws, just send them my way at the tables by the community shed.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send you the full repair-drive schedule and drop-off spots right away so you’ve got everything you need.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — that’ll help a lot. I’m heading to the tables by the community shed now, and I’ll keep an eye out for the schedule when it comes through.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Quinn: Great — I’ll get the schedule and drop-off spots to you right away, and I’ll keep spreading the word so everyone’s in the loop.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — I’m headed to the tables by the community shed now, and I’ll watch for the schedule when it comes through.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Quinn: Great — I’ll send the repair-drive schedule and drop-off spots right over so you have the details at the community shed.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll keep an eye out for it at the community shed and help guide folks once I’ve got the details.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Cleo: It’s coming along well so far — we’ve got a good bit gathered, but we could still use a few more donated tools and screws.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Rey: That’s great to hear — I’ll swing by the tables by the community shed and help sort anything that comes in.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — the community shed tables work well, and I’ll keep updating the supply list as things come in.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Opal: I’ll check the community center first, then head to the repair table by the front entrance.
events.speaker: Opal

prov.value: The repair drive is being held on Sunday at the community center.

events.text: Rey: Sounds good — I’ll meet you by the repair table at the front entrance.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Opal: Perfect — I’ll be there after the community center, then we can regroup at the front entrance repair table.
events.speaker: Opal

prov.value: The repair drive is being held on Sunday at the community center.

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll keep an eye out for the schedule at the community shed and help point folks the right way once it comes through.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Quinn: You got it — I’ll send the full repair-drive schedule and drop-off spots over right away so you have everything you need.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — I’m at the community shed tables now, so I’ll watch for it and help direct people once it arrives.
